content_record.title: historical-2025-mitochondrial-mutations-from-past-injuries-quietly-undermine-your-resi-167c9688
content_record.editorial_body: A new study shows that transient injuries trigger persistent mtDNA mutations that impair energy metabolism and increase future kidney injury risk—but adenosine repletion may restore ATP via AK4. Three things to remember - Transient injuries cause persistent mtDNA mutations that impair resilience. - Mutations suppress nucleotide metabolism; adenosine repletion restores ATP via AK4. - In 369,912 UK Biobank participants, mutation burden linked to kidney disease severity. Source This signal is based on Reversible compromise of physiological resilience by accumulation of heteroplasmic mtDNA mutations. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Observational and experimental; causality not established. Adenosine supplementation is not a proven treatment.
